en.dr-ali-peiravi: 2-82 Muhammad ibn Ali Majiluyih - may God be pleased with him - narrated that his uncle Muhammad ibn Abil-Qasim quoted Harun ibn Muslim, on the authority of Mus’adat ibn Sadaqah, on the authority of Ja’far ibn Muhammad (MGB) , on the authority of his father (MGB) that God’s Prophet (MGB) said, “
Nothing that a believer does is loved by the Honorable the Exalted God more than saying what is right whether he is pleased or angry.”
